That reasoning does not hold. The path (0,0)→(1,0)→(1,1) is legal, and each search can directly reach the other endpoint. Exceeding L is sufficient evidence, not necessary. Six cells do not certify membership in C, but connectivity inside the pocket still holds. Merely being able to move once does not guarantee reaching an arbitrary target.
